test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: general
question: The distance between two places A and B is 140 km. Two cars x and y start simultaneously from A and B, respectively. If they move in the same direction, they meet after 7 hours. If they move towards each other, they meet after one hour. What is the speed (in km/h) of car y if its speed is more than that of car x?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed in same direction = Total Distance ÷ Time = 140 ÷ 7 = 20 km/h

Relative speed in opposite direction = Total Distance ÷ Time = 140 ÷ 1 = 140 km/h

Speed of faster car (y) = (Sum of relative speeds + Difference of relative speeds) ÷ 2

Sy = (140 + 20) ÷ 2 = 160 ÷ 2 = 80 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 80 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance (D) = 140 km

Time taken in same direction (t₁) = 7 hours

Time taken in opposite direction (t₂) = 1 hour

Condition: Speed of y (Sy) > Speed of x (Sₓ)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe3234623fa66dcd9c9d90b20eda8e18edbafff923d5605617ad108355ece983.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Relative speed (Opposite direction) = S₁ + S₂

Relative speed (Same direction) = S₁ − S₂ (where S₁ > S₂)

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Case 1 (Opposite direction): Sy + Sₓ = 140 ÷ 1

⇒ Sy + Sₓ = 140 — (Equation 1)

⇒ Case 2 (Same direction): Sy − Sₓ = 140 ÷ 7

⇒ Sy − Sₓ = 20 — (Equation 2)

Adding Equation 1 and Equation 2:

⇒ (Sy + Sₓ) + (Sy − Sₓ) = 140 + 20

⇒ 2Sy = 160

⇒ Sy = 160 ÷ 2 = 80 km/h

Substituting Sy in Equation 1:

⇒ 80 + Sₓ = 140

⇒ Sₓ = 140 − 80 = 60 km/h

Checking condition: Sy (80) > Sₓ (60). Condition satisfied.

**∴ The correct answer is 80 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concept

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference (u − v). When they move in opposite directions, it is the sum (u + v).

Speed Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed for Constant Distance

If an object covers the same distance at speed u and then at speed v, the average speed is (2 × u × v) ÷ (u + v).</p
